classification: Metadata-only recorded environment aliasing; actual execution and output are unaffected
cause: run() combines env and extra into a fresh actual_env before subprocess execution, but appends extra itself to environmentOverrides. The caller later changes extra from jit-data to aot-data, so the final JSON incorrectly records aot-data for both commands.
futureRunnerCorrection: Copy dict(extra or {}) into environmentOverrides when recording a future run; retain this script unchanged as the actually executed input.
